units.source_text: 老婆子呆愣愣地站在那里，背上背着一个吃奶的婴儿，左右手各拖着一个小女孩，小的约莫三岁，大的也不过五岁。

en.t: The old woman stood there in a daze, carrying a nursing baby on her back and holding a little girl by each hand; the younger one was about three, and the older one no more than five.

units.source_text: 那个污秽的包袱里带着大饭团和咸梅。

en.t: In the dirty bundle she had brought large rice balls and salted plums.

units.source_text: 五六个矿工在安慰着老婆子。

en.t: Five or six miners were comforting the old woman.
I readily agreed to look after her.
